newsitem.title: UK: Triplex Lloyd extends offer for Wm Cook.
newsitem.headline: Triplex Lloyd extends offer for Wm Cook.

text.p: British engineering group Triplex Lloyd Plc said on Thursday that it had received acceptances for about 5.83 percent of the ordinary share capital in steel firm William Cook by the end of December 31, 1996.
Triplex also extended its hostile bid for William Cook to 1500 GMT on January 14, it said in a statement.
Triplex said that by 1500 GMT Tuesday, it had received valid acceptances covering some 1.09 million William Cook shares.
William Cook has rejected Triplex's bid which values Cook at about 309 pence per share.
